description: This file contains benchmarks for the 'scaled_grouped_mm' operator in PyTorch, including class definitions, configuration functions, and benchmark setup for different scaling modes and hardware support.

classes.name: ScaledGroupedMMBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class for testing scaled grouped matrix multiplication performance with various configurations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the benchmark with matrix dimensions, device, scaling mode, output dtype, and float8 dtype.

methods.name: _init_fp8
methods.description: Sets up FP8 tensorwise or rowwise scaled inputs for benchmarking.

methods.name: _init_mx_nvfp4
methods.description: Sets up MX or NVFP4 scaled inputs for benchmarking.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the scaled grouped matrix multiplication using the configured parameters.
